events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with potential for further conflict in the Middle East. This could lead to increased volatility in oil prices and global markets. The US and its allies are considering further action against Iran.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war could lead to increased volatility in global markets, with potential for a flight to safety in US assets. The SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY) could benefit from this, while the iShares MSCI Emerging Markets ETF (EEM) could be negatively impacted.

timeFrame.note: Monitor for further escalation of the conflict

events.exitStrategy: Exit if the conflict de-escalates or if the US and its allies announce a ceasefire.

events.title: US Interest Rate Hike
events.summary: The US Federal Reserve is considering an interest rate hike to combat inflation. This could lead to increased volatility in bond markets and impact global economic growth.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares Core US Aggregate Bond ETF (AGG)

events.reasoning: An interest rate hike could lead to increased volatility in bond markets, with potential for a flight to safety in longer-term US Treasury bonds. The iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF (TLT) could benefit from this, while the iShares Core US Aggregate Bond ETF (AGG) could be negatively impacted.

timeFrame.note: Monitor for further announcements from the Federal Reserve

events.exitStrategy: Exit if the Federal Reserve announces a pause in interest rate hikes or if inflation expectations decrease.

gains.conservativeNote: If the interest rate hike is modest
gains.extendedNote: If the interest rate hike is larger than expected
